purpose: Calibration lines (es-US): run every candidate voice through all of them; score native Mexican Spanish, consistency, numbers and prices, rep-count cadence against real rep timing, food words, English brand names inside Spanish, safety lines (clear and calm, never cute). Pick by ear with the cultural reviewer, then measure wpm.
